style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium tech climate-appliance ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cloud-mica light grey #F4F5F7, deep night blue-grey #232B36, luminous cyan-blue accent #33B6FF and champagne-gold trim accent #B99B6B, with charcoal text #2D2D2D kept for typography on light screens; cool temperature; soft directional studio key light from the upper left with gentle rim light and soft contact shadows, the vertical display strip glowing cyan-blue as the signature accent; modern geometric sans-serif type for headline and label typesetting; consistent thin-line icons in cyan-blue #33B6FF on rounded white cards; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; the tall cylindrical tower always upright with full height visible and a stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: the tall cylindrical tower always upright with full height visible and a stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale across the set
style.surfaceSystem: polished dark stone floor #1C232C with subtle reflections for mood shots, warm oak wood floor #C39A6B for footprint and home scenes
